author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine; built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1, v1.2 (best frozen so far), v1.3 (negative result, receipt 1f2894c4...751e). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1.
direction: Rusty, 2026-10-15: every reading is a fresh look at the present terrain from the present position; position = whole accumulated terrain AND basin occupancy; and YES, the organism's own readings deposit onto its position the way replies deposit onto the terrain.

rule.A_fresh_look: unchanged from v1.3: at every need, the unchanged full look over the present terrain. No hold anchor, no footprint gate.
rule.deposit: each look deposits its verdict onto the question's position: +1 if the look reads change (position AND persistence), -1 if it reads not-yet. Deposits never decay (forgiven, not forgotten: the record stays).
rule.crossing: the question PROPOSES at a look when its accumulated position is > 0, i.e. its own readings, taken together, say change. Otherwise it is HELD (UNKNOWN). The first look therefore behaves exactly as before: pass proposes, fail holds.
rule.v1_3_B_removed: Claude's v1.3 occupancy block test is removed; the deposit IS occupancy.

experiments: MAIN lambda 32, HIGH lambda 128, LOW_DESCRIPTIVE lambda 8; 6 families x 300 seeds; probe as v1.2; v1.2 and v1.3 A-only run alongside on identical worlds; BURST poison b = 5, 8 on NULL seeds 0-199 as v1.3.
